rationale: With assignment power, Justice Thomas is best positioned to write a text-forward majority holding that § 2244(b)(1) by its terms applies only to § 2254 and cannot be imported into § 2255 via § 2255(h)’s procedural cross-reference, while construing § 2244(b)(3)(E) narrowly enough to permit review. The Chief Justice and Justice Alito are likely to write (or join) dissents emphasizing AEDPA’s integrated structure and finality, and one or more concurrences may address the jurisdiction/clear-statement issues under Felker.
